---
applyTo: "**/*"
description: "Use when: adding or editing comments in source code"
---

# Comments

- Comments are not documentation: docs explain the system and its purpose; code comments explain decisions that are not clear from the code itself.
- Keep comments short, clear and easy for a tired human to read. A little humor, emojis, ASCII art or a diagram can make them more enjoyable.
- Add a brief comment when a non-obvious change needs context. Leave routine, self-explanatory code uncommented.
- Avoid repeating what the code or its names already say.
- Use plain language and avoid jargon unless it is needed.
- Add paragraph breaks to longer comments. Links or small diagrams are welcome when they clarify intent or behavior.
